name: DOC_RAG_KRX_BENCHMARK
description: A document-grounded retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) benchmark that evaluates models on answering queries using provided document collections (KRX-related content). It measures both retrieval quality and the faithfulness/accuracy of generated answers when grounded in the retrieved documents.
reputation: Niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage in document-RAG experiments.
